title: Optus SIM Only Large Choice Plus Plan 480GB $75/Month for 12 Months (New Services Only, $90/Month Ongoing) @ Optus
body:
Deal: Optus SIM Only Large Choice Plus Plan 480GB $75/Month for 12 Months (New Services Only, $90/Month Ongoing) @ Optus

[carrawa] So it is fixed to a location with the $5 a day 5gb roaming charge?
[daffyd] Standard mobile phone plan in Australia, $5 daily is for international roaming
"Get 5GB data for $5 to use in 24 hours in flight on selected airlines and abroad in 150+ Zone 1 destinations. Plus, get unlimited standard talk and text"
[carrawa] That is what I was wondering. Looked alright till I just noted the bottom section saying no data rollover so it had better be used up or a bit of a waste.
[hawkeye93] Multiple locations is fine. Went to Vietnam, transiting in Singapore and was charged $5 only.
[SiliconeFries] You are correct. Fixed. It's a postpaid with no lock in contract
[jv] Optus Super SIM Sale
Any good deals on Nano SIMs ?
[SiliconeFries] Nano SIM deals are hard to find because they're so small
[hawkeye93] Got on this plan last year when it was half price, good deal when you can combine with the $10 data sim deal to make it home internet as they share the data pool.
[Deal Hunting] Was only able to negotiate down to $70 a month with the Optus Loyalty team. Keen to know if anyone else has more success
